summary: Retest of the iteration_17 fixes. Monthly reports (one curl run plus a DB check): POST /api/cron/monthly-reports with the correct bearer, a new X-Webhook-Id and body {} returns 200 {accepted:true}. With last_report_sent unset, Al Noor (only admin dr.layla@sihha.ai, which cannot receive mail) was NOT updated. Eastern (no admins) was not updated. Jeddah, already at 2026-10, was skipped. The log reads 'Usage report not delivered to dr.layla@sihha.ai (user_b1000ae5aad6)'. A second run with every account at 2026-10 added no new log lines, so dedupe works. last_report_sent=2026-10 has been restored on all 3 sample accounts. Alerts panel at 390px: x=16 to 374 in both AR and EN, scrollWidth 390, no overflow. Desktop: AR x=196 to 516, EN x=1404 to 1724, both inside 1920. Toasts appear bottom-left in AR (x=32 to 388) and bottom-right in EN (x=1532 to 1888). demo-alert-save-btn can be clicked straight after an error toast in both languages. Arabic coverage is much improved: doctor dashboard 46 AR vs 32 EN nodes (mostly names and interpolated alert labels), accounts list fully translated (Subscribed/Trial badges, count line 'جارٍ العرض 3 من 3 حسابات'), demo requests page fully translated (title, nav, filter chips, badges, select options), workspace onboarding almost complete, medication form fully translated. Regression: typing works in AR, the input value survives AR→EN→AR→EN toggles, English mode shows 0 Arabic nodes, no page errors. Language was reset to English at the end.

minor.issue: Returns 400 'Invalid body' when there is no JSON body, even when X-Webhook-Id is present. Fine if the cron runner always sends a body; otherwise make the body optional when the header is present.

ui_bugs.issue: Textarea placeholders are never translated. SKIP includes 'textarea' and el.closest(SKIP) matches the textarea itself, so the attribute pass skips it. Example: the demo requests notes placeholder 'Notes — call outcome, next step…' stays English even though it is in ar.json. Fix: only skip text-node translation inside textarea, not attribute translation on the textarea element.

ui_bugs.component: Sonner toasts / English-mode language toggle (Arabic text)
ui_bugs.issue: The toast uses sonner's default system-ui font stack, not IBM Plex Sans Arabic. In the test browser, Arabic toast text and the 'العربية' toggle label in EN mode render with disconnected glyphs. Fix: set the toast font to the Arabic font, e.g. html[lang=ar] [data-sonner-toast] { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', ... }, and apply the Arabic font to the toggle label.

When scrolled, the briefing headline appears clipped at the start ('nnual check-up with stable vitals...'), which looks like truncate/overflow in RTL. The account switcher in the AR sidebar also shows '...cialist Hospital'. Minor.

design_issues.screen: Remaining English in Arabic mode (data, names and dates excluded)
issues: Doctor dashboard: interpolated alert group labels ('2 screenings needing attention', '174 medication alerts', '14 appointment updates', '6 prescription alerts', '2 vital alerts', '1 refill alert'), the kind badges 'VITAL' / 'REFILL' and the date 'Monday, November 2'. The dictionary cannot match strings that contain counts; use t() with a template.

Encounter detail: 'MEDIUM PRIORITY' / 'LOW PRIORITY' badges (split nodes 'medium' + 'priority'), the trend label 'stable', 'recently added', '97% adherence ·', the 'Review & Sign' button, and the suggested-question chips 'Why was ... flagged?' (the RTL bidi also scrambles the trailing punctuation).

My Hospital / workspace overview: '+0 in the last 30 days' and '0 in the last 30 days' (ar.json has 'in the last 30 days' but the leading number blocks the lookup), and '1 doctors · 1 hospital admins'.

Workspace onboarding checklist items 3 and 8: 'A subdomain such as care.hospital.sa and someone in IT who can add one DNS record.' and 'A signed data processing agreement covering Saudi PDPL before real patient data is imported.'
Workspace features tab: 'Uses global (on)'. Import tab: a stray 'and'.
Landing: the AudienceTabs point 'AI health chat and screening with a clear next step' is untranslated. Trust chips are hospital names, which is fine by design.
Medication form: the pack-size placeholder 'e.g. 30' is untranslated.
Success toast 'Alerts go to <email>' stays English in AR (interpolated).
My Hospital / workspace report month uses the native <input type=month> picker, not a shadcn-style picker.

action_items: Translate interpolated strings (counts, templates) with t() templates instead of relying on dictionary text matching: doctor alert group labels, 'N in the last 30 days', 'N doctors · N hospital admins', 'N% adherence', 'Alerts go to {email}'

Add the missing ar.json entries: priority badges, 'stable', 'recently added', 'Review & Sign', the 'Why was … flagged?' template, onboarding items 3 and 8, 'Uses global (on)', the AudienceTabs 'AI health chat and screening with a clear next step', 'e.g. 30'
Fix translateAttrs so textarea placeholders get translated
Set the Arabic font on sonner toasts
Clean up ar.json: about 78 garbage keys were captured from source code (e.g. line 84 '); toast.success(data.email ? `Alerts go to $' and line 1759 'placeholder=\"Notes…\" data-testid=')
critical_code_review_comments: ar.json has extraction artefacts: keys that contain JSX or JS fragments (data-testid=, toast., className=). They are harmless but noisy and will never match.

send_monthly_reports and _deliver_reset_email are now correct: per-month dedupe via last_report_sent != month, the account is only marked when at least one email was sent, and the log includes the kind and recipient.
LanguageContext lookup strips only edge punctuation, not numbers, so any string with a count is never translated.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all 4 fixes verified; remaining items are smaller Arabic gaps)

seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily unset last_report_sent on the sample accounts and then restored it to 2026-10 on all 3. Demo alert email restored to delivered+sihha-demo@resend.dev.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cron needs a JSON body ({}) plus the bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET. The current report month is 2026-10 (system date is Nov 2026). Encounters with artifacts: enc_fc5e6d2f320f, enc_2cead3245352 (dr.layla). Workspace tabs use data-testid account-tab-{key}, not account-*-tab. The English-node counter skips names, emails and medicine names by design.
